title: Will encryption hide it?
instruction: You are messaging a friend. What does encryption hide, and what doesn’t it?

items.text: The content of a message from people on the same public Wi-Fi
items.why: On the same network they see only an encrypted jumble.

items.text: An end-to-end encrypted message from the app’s server
items.why: The server has no key; it carries only a jumble.

items.text: A screenshot that your friend forwards
items.why: On her phone the message is already unlocked.

items.text: Text turned into numbers using a public table
items.why: That is encoding. Anyone who knows the table can read it.

items.text: A password sent to an app over https
items.why: Nobody can read it on the way.

items.text: A message that someone reads over your shoulder
items.why: On the screen the message is unlocked.

debrief: Encryption protects a message on its way from anyone who doesn’t have the key. It doesn’t protect it from what the recipient does with it.
